Model interpretation

How the network and curve relate

The network shows where momentum starts, how it crosses clusters, and when adoption becomes self-reinforcing.

Understanding lift

Higher understanding speeds early awareness and improves the odds that confident buyers emerge fast enough to seed the market.

Social proof

Proof amplifies neighbor effects, turning isolated wins into visible signals that push adoption forward.

Connections between segments

Bridge nodes carry momentum between segments. If they convert, diffusion reaches the mainstream much earlier.

Scenario controls

Adoption assumptions

The network remains fixed while the three assumptions change, which makes scenarios comparable.

72%
Raises early awareness and makes confident adoption more likely once people engage.
64%
Strengthens neighbor effects so each adopter produces more visible downstream confidence.
58%
Improves spread between segments so momentum reaches the mainstream before it stalls.
